patterns.note: Dark-themed, full-width sections with generous vertical padding, creating a spacious and premium feel.
Strong sans-serif hierarchy with large, impactful headings and smaller, legible body text, complemented by uppercase labels for sub-headings and categories.
Dominant dark charcoal background (#3a3d39) paired with a single, consistent teal accent color (#61827f) for CTAs and key visual elements, creating a sophisticated contrast.
A full-bleed video hero plays on loop in the initial viewport. Sections appear to fade or slide into view as the user scrolls down the page, creating a dynamic reveal.
Prominent trust signals, including enterprise logos, statistics, and testimonials, are strategically integrated throughout the page to build authority and credibility.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero is used as the primary visual, playing on loop with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text legibility.
The header navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining its appearance and functionality as the user scrolls.
Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth and engaging scrolling experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~4-5x body text) with clear, legible body and smaller uppercase labels, establishing a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (~4-8px) on buttons, cards, and input fields, providing a soft, modern touch.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of spaciousness and clarity.

standout: The site's distinctive dark, sophisticated aesthetic combined with the subtle, yet impactful, teal accent color immediately conveys a sense of security and modern professionalism. The full-bleed video hero, rather than a static image, adds a dynamic and high-tech feel, setting it apart from typical enterprise SaaS sites.
